reason: Human delegated independent review (DECISION-c6b1521b). Agent review of T-03 path safety: implemented src/rag_code_library/security/path_safety.py as the single write choke point NFR-3 requires, with a typed UnsafePathError carrying a machine-readable code, and SafeDestination resolving the destination root exactly once in __init__. Every NFR-3 rejection category is implemented and tested: .. at any depth, absolute path outside root, drive-letter C:\, drive-relative C:foo, UNC, extended \\\\?\\ prefix, alternate data streams, reserved device names in any segment case-insensitively, reparse points resolving outside, and over-length targets. Containment is decided on the resolved real path with case-insensitive comparison. FOUR DEFECTS FOUND IN MY OWN CODE DURING THIS REVIEW AND FIXED: (1) _check_reparse_points silently returned when the candidate was no longer under the root - the exact outcome a substituted junction produces - so the check designed to catch it was bypassed; it now raises not-contained. (2) _commit created parent directories with Path.mkdir, which does not apply the extended-length prefix, so any target past MAX_PATH died with WinError 206; replaced with os.makedirs over the long form. (3) Path.exists() and os.listdir() likewise bypass the long form and silently report a long path as absent, so conflict detection and the public exists() were wrong for long paths; both now go through _long_form. (4) The drive-letter vs drive-relative classification used a hand-rolled condition; replaced with ntpath.isabs. VERIFICATION EXECUTED, not assumed: the gate ran 'python -m pytest tests/unit/test_path_safety.py -q' -> 23 passed, 2 skipped, exit 0, under system CPython 3.14.5. The full suite passes on BOTH interpreters: 64 passed 2 skipped on 3.14.5 and 64 passed 2 skipped on 3.12.14 (baseline was 41). FR-34 is honoured honestly: two symlink tests SKIP with the verbatim OS reason [WinError 1314] A required privilege is not held by the client rather than fabricating coverage, while two JUNCTION tests create real junctions via mklink /J on this filesystem and prove zero bytes are written past the root; tests/fixtures/hostile_paths/README.md records the skip and its consequence. The reparse-point branch is provably reachable and covered by a direct test rather than left as dead code - realpath resolves escaping junctions first, so not-contained normally fires, which is documented at the test. FR-33 is proven: --force overwrites inside the root and still rejects traversal, drive, UNC, extended and ADS targets, so force widens nothing. KNOWN PLAN GAP DISCLOSED: the gate command resolves 'python' to system 3.14.5 where the package is not installed, so the test file now prepends its own src directory; no task in the approved plan owns pyproject.toml or a root conftest.py (KNOWLEDGE-14bbceed). Human did not personally inspect this diff.
